name: context-lifecycle-handoffs
description: Behavioral scenarios for isolated forward-testing. Expected outcomes are evaluated from artifacts/actions; validate_suite.py checks structure only and is not a Harness.

evals.setup: Two products and three scratch runs exist. User names EXP-42 whose ticket links req-v3 and D-4; unrelated billing records exist.
evals.prompt: Prepare the active change for implementation in a cold session.
evals.expected_output: Resolve EXP-42 from explicit selection, load only relevant spec/criteria/design and active review findings, preserve IDs; do not select newest directory or read every domain.

evals.setup: EXP-42 already links specs/export.md with FR-7/AC-9, accepted D-4, and an existing independently deliverable child EXP-42-A.
evals.prompt: Prepare delivery and decompose the remaining independent slice, then repeat unchanged.
evals.expected_output: Reuse canonical spec and IDs without duplicate normative text; reuse child A and create only missing child with parent and depends_on; run checklist is not a shadow tracker; repeated reconciliation is a no-op.

evals.setup: Accepted prototype section export has D-4 rationale only in scratch; code later lands with criterion evidence.
evals.prompt: Retain the choice now, hand it off, and clean finished execution scratch after landing.
evals.expected_output: Retain consequential decision/basis/alternatives/revisions at acceptance before component docs. Keep ticket/spec/design/final verification; essential links and rationale remain usable without scratch; code is behavior and prototype is intent without maintaining a second UI.

evals.setup: AC-9 evidence and D-4 depend on API-2 v1. API-2 v2 changes export semantics. BILL-2 uses API-9 unchanged.
evals.expected_output: Preserve accepted/completed statuses and prior evidence; mark only materially affected conclusions needs review naming API-2 v2, follow relevant transitive dependents, route owners; BILL-2 remains current.

evals.setup: AC-9 passes at code abc123/staging-v4; AC-10 was not run; a new config staging-v5 changes callbacks.
evals.expected_output: Map criteria to executed evidence and exact revision/environment. Record failures and omissions, preserve separate Standards/Spec axes; reassess affected v5 evidence and block unsupported readiness despite a high pass percentage.

evals.setup: EXP-42 refactor moves export scheduling across a module boundary; AC-9 behavior is unchanged; ADR-3 states the old boundary.
evals.expected_output: Establish before/after invariant/criterion checks at known revisions/environment, retain structural delta/preservation evidence, update System State and amend/supersede ADR-3 without losing rationale; external behavior changes return to Product/Design.

evals.setup: Verification covers artifact sha256:42 at abc123, staging-v4; release candidate sha256:43 was rebuilt with new config.
evals.prompt: Prepare release evidence and next action using existing deployment tooling.
evals.expected_output: Same change identity throughout; do not attach old verdict to artifact 43 without reassessment. Evidence identifies artifact/build/env/gates/migration/observability/rollback and omissions. No deploy is implied by handoff.

evals.setup: A patch and claim request were prepared at v1. Current record v2 adds privacy constraint and another answer. Task already claimed by agent-A.
evals.prompt: Reconcile the contribution and claim the task for agent-B.
evals.expected_output: Reread target/premises; preserve current edits, match IDs, reject stale claim overwrite and require explicit transfer; without atomic claims or single writer execute serially. Repeat unchanged patch produces no duplicate record.

evals.setup: Code/tests establish admin web export completion, partial mobile behavior, and no demand interviews. Repository has tightly coupled internals.
evals.prompt: Map the current product without an architecture review.
evals.expected_output: Record observable behavior, roles, flows, source revision and coverage; preserve evidence/inference/commitment distinction. Do not require cohesion/coupling/API/data-model assessments or treat code as demand evidence; route substantive technical questions separately.

evals.setup: Only suite skills are installed; no plan/implement skill or Agent tool exists. Accepted requirements and approach are available.
evals.prompt: Deliver the approved change with tests.
evals.expected_output: Active agent performs workflow planning/execution directly with existing tools; reuse canonical tickets/run plan and criterion-based checks. Never invoke missing skills or require delegation; unresolved substantive blockers remain explicit.
